Capability.meaning: Explicit operation grant on a resource or permission scope.

PrincipalGroup.meaning: Direct membership in a configured role or user group; a group can itself be a member. Supplied by trusted configuration or an authoritative identity source, never inferred from an agent-chosen name.

ResourceGroup.meaning: Permission-scope membership; grants on a parent apply to its descendants.

InGroup.meaning: Direct or nested role/user-group membership from PrincipalGroup. Membership alone is not permission.

Can.meaning: Grant including declared principal and resource memberships; not final authorization.

Field.meaning: Host-observed field or association of an application object or event. The binding defines cardinality, value type, fixed unit and optional observation-time field; never agent claims or hidden policy decisions.

Event.meaning: An event observed by the host, with its ID, actor and kind; recording it does not imply permission or success.

scope: Captured gate inputs and mediated callbacks. Outcomes follow the trusted adapter's confirmation contract; they are not independent proof of business success or authentic identity. Unmediated channels and missing observations remain outside this trace.

**Rating: Watchlist. Composite score 5.7/10.** No position at $344.63 (close 2026-10-30; market cap $5,029.6bn). Action: 1–2% starter at $240–265; 3–4% full position at or below $225, capped at 4%; trim above $395. Horizon 12–24 months.

**Thesis.** Apple is a high-quality franchise at a price that capitalises its best margin year as if permanent: on a margin-adjusted FY2027 EPS of $8.87 at the five-year average multiple of 30.2x, fair value is $268, 22% below the close. The probability-weighted value of the three cases is $266, a 23% negative return, so it becomes investable only in the $240–265 band.

**Main risks.** The ~50% gross margin may be a tariff-refund and memory-timing peak (June included 2.0 points of refunds; the September guide of 47–48% is call-stated, not in the release). The ~$20bn search payment is 22% of services gross profit and survives only on one-year non-exclusive terms with appeals pending. China grew 30% in nine months but faces an expected 20% unit decline in H2 2026. The multiple sits at the 100th percentile of its five-year range, and the DOJ case heads toward a 2027 trial.

**One question.** Is Apple's ~50% gross margin a new floor, or a tariff-refund and memory-timing peak that flatters trailing EPS? The 2026-11-02 December-quarter guide decides it.

**Three takeaways.** (1) Watchlist, zero position at $344.63: base $268 and probability-weighted $266, a 23% negative return despite the franchise. (2) Buy bands are $240–265 for a starter and at or below $225 for a full position, capped because one regulatory event is worth 9.4% of market value. (3) The 2026-11-02 guide decides the case: at or above 48% gross margin ex-refund the base moves toward $296; near 45% it converges on the $205 bear.

**Data requests (some behind logins/fees).** U1: PACER dockets for the DOJ case (D.N.J. 2:24-cv-04055 and MDL 2:24-md-03113) — trial date and remedy scope. U2: USPTO/EPO patent export for Apple, 2024–2026, in AI, health sensing, foldables and AR/VR. U3: Companies Registration Office Ireland accounts for the three main Irish entities — entity-level profit and IP ownership. U4: Apple's 2026-07-30 earnings-call transcript — the exact September guidance, which the release does not contain.

**Further diligence.** The December guide's margin ex-refund; the first renewal terms of the search payment; the annual report's refund and inventory split; China revenue against its nine-month base; and Services growth after the US link-out injunction.

This report is for research purposes only and is not investment advice.
